statements.statement: For a mono u:A->B representing xi, composition identifies Sub(A) with the principal ideal below xi in Sub(B).
statements.argument: Composition sends a mono a:X->A to u a. It is well-defined on subobject classes. A factorization a=b h gives u a=u b h, while the reverse implication cancels the mono u, so order is both preserved and reflected. Any mono m:X->B below [u] has m=u a. Then a is monic, since a r=a s implies m r=m s and hence r=s. Thus every subobject below [u] occurs. The induced map is an order isomorphism onto that ideal; no existence of pullbacks is used.
statements.outcome: Passed for the actual represented subobjects. The proof does not decide any disputed glyph or the abbreviation isom/iso.

The preceding bijective correspondence makes that the arrow associated with d_n, and composition with the identity leaves every subobject class unchanged. Thus u_{d_n}=id_{J_n}. The stated singleton fiber is the preceding page result carried in scope, not independently reproved here.
statements.outcome: Passed. The local n-prime/n reading in the Lorsque clause remains an ink question.

statements.place: Three-object diagram and displayed composite, then stabilité statement
statements.statement: For eta of type n-double-prime in J_n-prime and xi of type n-prime in J_n, u_xi^n u_eta^{n-prime}=u_zeta^n where zeta=u_xi^n(eta), and evaluation at d_n-double-prime gives zeta.
statements.argument: Let u:D_n-prime->D_n and v:D_n-double-prime->D_n-prime represent xi and eta. The induced maps satisfy u_* v_*([a])=[u v a]=(u v)_*([a]) for every subobject representative a. The composite mono u v represents zeta=u_*(eta), of type n-double-prime. The Hom/fiber uniqueness from scan008 identifies the induced map of u v with u_zeta^n. On the top identity subobject the same calculation gives [u v]=zeta. Hence the admissible maps arising from M are closed under composition.
statements.outcome: Passed for realized data. This does not claim closure for arbitrary abstract N, J, tau and rho; that is a condition required in reconstruction.

statements.place: Reconstituer M à equivalence près paragraph and final definition of M_0
statements.statement: With identity admissible maps and the stated composition closure, M_0 with objects N and admissible Hom sets is a category equivalent to the original M.
statements.argument: Use ordinary function composition on admissible order maps. Closure is supplied by the preceding composite calculation and identity maps by the unit calculation; associativity and unit laws follow from function composition. Choose the already fixed representatives D_n. The full subcategory on them maps to M_0 by sending an arrow to its induced subobject map. This preserves identity and composition. On each Hom set it is onto by the definition of admissible maps and injective by the scan008 evaluation argument, so it is an isomorphism of the representative category with M_0. Every object of M is isomorphic to its selected representative, giving the stated equivalence. For unrelated abstract input the identity and closure conditions must be imposed; their sufficiency here is conditional on those conditions and the recorded Hom/fiber data.
statements.outcome: Passed under the stated hypotheses and closure/identity conditions. No additional axiomatization of arbitrary input data or size theorem is claimed.
